caption: The drawing consists of three semicircular sections oriented with their flats sides facing down, arranged in a roughly triangular composition on a cream-colored background. At the top is the largest semicircle, outlined in yellow and bordered in black, containing a large peach-colored face with brown eyes, small lips, and lightly blushed cheeks. This face is set against a background shaded in green and gray. Flanking the face, two circular maps with black geographic text show parts of the world labeled as Atlantic Ocean, Arctic Ocean, and other regions. On either side of the upper semicircle are small, square, decorative elements: each features a starburst pattern in red, yellow, and brown on a tan background. Below the largest semicircle and separated from it by empty space is a wide arc labeled with numbers from 55 to 05 to 60, arranged along the curve, with additional numbers in black directly under the curve as: 11, 60, 10, 1. Directly underneath this are the words “scale in inches” in small handwriting. At the bottom left and right are two more medium semicircles, also outlined in yellow. The left semicircle contains a scene of a windmill on a brown hill, with a blue-roofed building beside it, green landscape in the foreground, and a sky fading from yellow to blue in the background. The right semicircle contains a seascape with a large wooden sailing ship, with an American flag on the stern, sailing on blue and yellow water under a sky transitioning from yellow to blue, and land with green and brown colors is visible in the background. Underneath each of these medium semicircles are two small half-circle calibration scales, marked with fine black lines and numbers. The artist’s name, “Francis Law Vorhees,” is written in the lower right corner.
title: Moon Disc Paintings for Grandfather's Clock
